info.title: Zivoo API
info.description: Parent and device APIs for the Zivoo learning toy. All routes are versioned under /v1. Errors use {error: {code, message, details}}.

post.description:
Release devices, delete children (cascades sessions), and mark the
account deleted. The identity-provider user must also be deleted by the
server-side admin job (see docs/OPERATIONS.md); the app signs out.

schema.title: Response List Children V1 Children Get
Response List Devices V1 Devices Get

delete.description:
Remove from this account. The toy can no longer reach this family's
profiles, preferences or sessions, and queued commands are cancelled. Its
own credential is kept so a new owner can set it up with the setup code.
(Credential revocation is an operations action for compromised units.)

schema.title: Response List Activities V1 Activities Get

post.description: Child walked away or interrupted. Idempotent.

ChildUtteranceIn.title: ChildUtteranceIn
ChildUtteranceIn.description: What the toy heard. Text comes from on-cloud STT; confidence from that STT.

LearningPreferencesIn.title: LearningPreferencesIn
LearningPreferencesIn.description: Full preferences document; the client sends the whole thing with base_version.
